methodology: Only verified, publication-approved evidence may appear publicly. Merged upstream records are independently public evidence of acceptance, not proof of deployment, active use, or operational outcome.

entries.source: Public merged upstream pull request, released installation state, and official upstream documentation
entries.use_case: Integrate AIDebug into REMnux malware-analysis provisioning and document its AI and static-analysis categories.
entries.outcome: Lenny Zeltser merged PR #355 on 2026-10-07. The installation state is included in salt-states v2026.41.4; official upstream documentation credits Andrey Pautov and 1200km.com.
entries.limitations: Accepted upstream integration and documented authorship do not establish certification, audited security, a new VM image, independent runtime testing, adoption counts, or endorsement of every feature. The maintainer documents offline mode and external LLM transmission.
